articles.title: CAPTCHA Verification System
articles.search_text: CAPTCHA Verification System The CAPTCHA check shown while hunting to prevent abnormal play. Home Must Read The NEED server uses a CAPTCHA verification system to prevent abnormal auto-hunting and macro use. A check for normal play A CAPTCHA can appear even during normal play. Enter the characters shown on the screen within the time limit to pass. Contents When does a CAPTCHA appear? How to Verify Reward for Passing If You Fail Notes A CAPTCHA window can appear while hunting under certain conditions. It is not meant to punish any particular player: it checks for long repeated hunting and abnormal automated play. When the CAPTCHA window appears, enter the characters shown in the image. The answer may be case-sensitive, so type it exactly as shown. Time limit The CAPTCHA must be entered within the time limit. Going over the limit may count as a failure. Passing the CAPTCHA gives 1 Mythril Coin as a reward for normal play. 1 Mythril Coin can be exchanged for 500 Cash. Verification reward 1 Mythril Coin Repeated wrong answers or timeouts may flag you as a suspected macro user. To limit the damage from honest mistakes, this currently sends you to jail instead of an immediate permanent ban. Please note A CAPTCHA can appear even during normal play. When it does, stay calm and enter the characters on the screen. Failing repeatedly may lead to sanctions. The CAPTCHA trigger rate, reward and sanction criteria may be adjusted depending on the server situation.

articles.title: 🔨 Refining Guide
articles.search_text: 🔨 Refining Guide Refining Guide The basics of refining equipment and how to refine. Refining System Refining improves equipment. Depending on the equipment type it raises ATK, DEF, MATK and more, and some equipment gains extra effects at high refine levels. Safe Refine Range Regular equipment can be refined safely up to +4. Within the safe range, a failed refine does not destroy the equipment. Range Description +1 ~ +4 Safe refine range +5 and up Equipment may break on failure Regular Refining Refine weapons with Oridecon and armor with Elunium. The higher the refine level, the lower the success rate. Enriched Refining Enriched Elunium and Enriched Oridecon give a higher success rate than regular refining. The equipment can still break on failure. Refining Tips For expensive equipment, using a Blacksmith's Blessing is recommended. Refine bonuses can differ from one piece of equipment to another. Some equipment unlocks strong options above a certain refine level. The success rate depends on the refine level. Note Some equipment may follow different rules from regular refining, and the refining system may change with events or updates.

Home Enchant Temporal Boots The standard enchantable gear most jobs wear after level 99. Contents Overview Temporal Boots Types Crafting Normal Enchant Hidden Enchant Socketed Boots Enchant Materials Location References Temporal Boots are the standard enchantable gear obtained in the Glast Heim Memorial Dungeon. The level 130 and level 160 Glast Heim instances drop the Temporal Boots crafting materials and enchant materials. There are 6 Temporal Boots, one per stat, so each job can pick the one that suits it. 1 Temporal Crystal crafts the basic Temporal Boots. Crafted Temporal Boots plus 5 Temporal Crystal let you craft the Temporal Boots type of your choice. Slotless Temporal Boots can get 4 normal enchants in total. For a normal enchant you choose the option type yourself, and the success rate is 100%. Temporal Boots with all 4 enchants done can get the final hidden enchant. The hidden enchant success rate of slotless Temporal Boots is 100%. Bear's Power Muscle Fool Hawk Eye Speed of Light Runaway Magic Lucky Day Option Details For the detailed effects of the hidden enchants, see the in-game item info or the server database. Slotless Temporal Boots plus 5 Temporal Crystals craft socketed Temporal Boots. Adding a Socket The slotless → socketed conversion succeeds 50% of the time; on failure the equipment is destroyed. Socketed Temporal Boots can likewise get 4 normal enchants and 1 hidden enchant. On socketed Temporal Boots, a failed enchant destroys the equipment, and enchants cannot be reset. Home Enchant Gigant Snake Skin Gigant Snake Skin (Faceworm's Nest) The main mid-to-late game gear enchant system, obtained through Memorial Dungeon time attack rewards. Contents Faceworm's Nest Overview How to Get It Time Attack Rewards Extra Options Gigant Snake Skin is equipment obtained as a Faceworm's Nest time attack reward. Its extra options, slots and refine level depend on the dungeon clear time. Clearing the Memorial Dungeon gives a reward box. The time attack result decides the extra options on the Gigant Snake Skin and the Temporal Manteau. Key Point The faster the clear, the higher the tier of extra options you get. Avoid the traps in the dungeon and defeat the boss quickly. The time attack result decides the refine level, the number of slots and the extra stats. The extra stats are random among STR, AGI, VIT, INT, DEX and LUK.

Home Enchant RWC An accessory enchant system that adds special stats to the RWC Memorial Ring and the RWC Memorial Pendant. Contents Overview Enchant Order Socket Enchant Hidden Enchant Ring Enchant Pendant Enchant Notes Location References A system that adds up to 4 hidden enchants to the RWC Memorial Ring and the RWC Memorial Pendant. Like Fallen Angel Wings, it is an enchant for expensive equipment with few real enchant chances. Enchants go in slot order 4 → 3 → 2 → 1. Equipment with a created socket can only be enchanted in slots 4 → 3 → 2. The Socket Enchant turns the RWC Memorial Ring and Pendant into the RWC Memorial Ring [1] and the RWC Memorial Pendant [1]. Entry Details Success Rate 50% On Failure Equipment destroyed Restriction Not available for equipment with a hidden enchant You choose the option type for each slot; the option value is random. Destruction Chance Enchanting slot 1 or 2 destroys the equipment with a 25% chance. No Reset An applied enchant cannot be reset, but a RWC Enchant Reset Ticket resets the enchants once. Slot Available Options Slots 3~4 Fighting Spirit, ATK%, MHP%, HP Slots 1~2 STR, AGI, VIT, INT, DEX, LUK, SP Main options: Fighting Spirit Lv 1~3, ATK +1~3%, MHP +1~3%, HP +100~300 Spell, MATK%, SP STR, AGI, VIT, INT, DEX, LUK, MHP%, HP Main options: Spell Lv 1~3, MATK +1~3%, SP +25~75 Expensive Equipment RWC enchants can destroy the equipment, so proceed carefully. Before You Enchant Store Stones in the Wardrobe Box List Related Pages What Are Costume Enchant Stones? Costume Enchant Stones are card options you can add to costume equipment. Add an Enchant Stone to a costume in the enchant zone to apply its option. Stones Become Bound An Enchant Stone added in the enchant zone becomes bound to the costume you enchanted. An Enchant Stone, once added, cannot be moved to another costume, so choose carefully. Use the Wardrobe If you want an Enchant Stone option on several costumes, we strongly recommend storing the Enchant Stone in the Wardrobe. An Enchant Stone stored in the Wardrobe keeps its option while you switch between different costume appearances. Go to Costume System The box available now is the Costume Enchant Stone Box. articles.title: About the Costume System
articles.search_text: About the Costume System An introduction to the NEED server's Costume Album, Wardrobe and Enchant Stone systems. Home Costume Guide Costume System Costume Collection Over 2,000 costumes are registered so far, and new costumes will keep being added. Registering Costumes Obtain a costume. Register it in the Costume Album. Each registration gives 1 Costume Coin (character-bound). A registered costume is stored permanently in the Costume Album. The original costume item is used up when you register it. To wear it later, you receive it as a rental, and it becomes a character-bound costume. The character that registered it first can use the costume right away. Note If you register several costumes for the same slot, only the last one registered is delivered to your inventory. The earlier ones are still saved in the album: store them in the Wardrobe and take them out when you need them. Costume Unlock Registered costumes can be unlocked for your account so that your other characters can use them too. Entry Details First registering character Usable right after registering Account unlock cost 100,000,000 Zeny Account unlock effect Usable by every character on the same account Wardrobe Slots Expand the Wardrobe's slots to store more costumes. Base slots 4 slots Expansion step +4 slots Maximum slots 80 slots Expansion cost 1,000,000 Zeny for the first, rising with each expansion Album Registration Rewards Keep collecting costumes to earn extra rewards: 100 costumes registered = 30 Costume Coins. Enchant Stones are registered per character. A registered stone applies permanently to that character. A registered costume you take out comes with the enchant already applied. articles.title: NEED Grace
articles.search_text: NEED Grace A timed per-character buff that Gold Coins activate for 6 hours each, plus weekly convenience passes. Home Event Content NEED Grace is a timed per-character buff activated with Gold Coins. Each Gold Coin gives 6 hours, and it applies only to the current character, not the whole account. Applies per character NEED Grace applies per character, not per account. Other characters on the same account do not get it. Contents 1. How to Activate 2. How to Get Gold Coins 3. Buff Effects 4. Weekly Grace Passes 5. Notes 6. Location How to Activate Use Gold Coins at the dedicated NPC to activate NEED Grace or extend it. Each Gold Coin gives 6 hours. Item Used Time Added Description 1 Gold Coin 6 hours Adds 6 hours to the NEED Grace buff. Several Gold Coins Coins used × 6 hours If Grace is already active, the time is added after the time left. How to Get Gold Coins The Gold Coins that activate NEED Grace come from server events, writing player guides, community activity rewards and more. Source Server events Rewards from events run on the server, such as official events, test participation, hunting efficiency measurements and Battlegrounds tests. Writing player guides May be given for writing walkthroughs, job guides or content guides that help new and returning players. Community activity May be given for useful activity that helps run the server, such as reports, sharing information and improving guides. About rewards How many Gold Coins are given, and when, depends on the event, the quality of the guide and the server situation. Buff Effects While NEED Grace is active, its own icon appears in the buff bar, showing the time left and the effects. Effect Value All Stats +1 MaxHP +3% MaxSP Item drop rate +50% Stacks with Bubble Gum The NEED Grace drop rate bonus applies together with Bubble Gum. The final drop rate may still be capped by the server's drop rate limit. Weekly Grace Passes Besides the buff, the NEED Grace Manager sells rental tickets for weekly convenience features. A convenience pass is delivered to your inventory as a ticket; right-click it to see how long it has left. The buff and the passes are separate The NEED Grace buff gives stat, HP, SP and drop rate effects. The Trade, Elemental, Storage and All-in-One Grace Passes are a separate system that unlocks convenience features. Pass Main Feature Conditions / Notes Trade Grace Pass Overcharge / Discount convenience Gives the Overcharge and Discount convenience effects while the pass lasts. Elemental Grace Pass Use the @element command Enter @element to choose Water, Wind, Earth or Fire. The endowment lasts 30 minutes. Storage Grace Pass Use the @autostorage command In town, automatically stores the Usable, Etc and Card items in your inventory that you already have in Storage. Equipment is left out. All-in-One Grace Pass All of Trade, Elemental and Storage Grace One pass gives every Trade, Elemental and Storage Grace feature. Convenience Commands Command @element With an Elemental or All-in-One Grace Pass active, choose a Water, Wind, Earth or Fire endowment in town. @autostorage With a Storage or All-in-One Grace Pass active, automatically puts matching items into Storage in town. @storeexclude <item ID> Adds the item to the auto-storage exclusion list. @storeexcludelist Shows the auto-storage exclusion list. @storeexcludeoff <item ID> Removes the item from the auto-storage exclusion list. Town-only convenience @autostorage works only in town, so it cannot be abused for weight management or convenience during combat. Notes Weekly Grace Passes are per-character rental tickets. Their time is not shared with other characters on the same account. An active All-in-One Grace Pass gives every Trade, Elemental and Storage Grace feature. A rental ticket disappears when its time runs out. Check whether a feature is actually available in the in-game Grace status and the NPC's guidance. NEED Grace applies only to the current character. Logging in with another character on the same account does not share the effect. Using another pass while Grace is active adds the time after the time left. Grace effects end automatically when the buff time runs out. Location The NEED Grace Manager is at the location below. NEED Grace Manager

articles.title: New/Returning Player FAQ
articles.search_text: New/Returning Player FAQ FAQ for New and Returning Players Questions new and returning players often ask. Home FAQ Q. Which episode is the server on? A. See the Current Server Stage page for the NEED server's current progress. Q. What should I do first? A. Check the Server Roadmap first, then use the Content Guide and the Equipment Guide to plan how to progress. Q. Where do I get equipment? A. Equipment drops from many kinds of content, such as Memorial Dungeons, regular dungeons and Illusion Dungeons. See Equipment by Content for details. Q. Where do I enter Memorial Dungeons? A. The Warp Helper takes you to most Memorial Dungeons. See the Content Guide for details. Q. Are costumes shared across my account? A. Register a costume in the Costume Album and unlock the account wardrobe, and every character on the same account can use it. Q. What is the account unlock? A. It opens your registered costumes to the other characters on your account. Unlocking the account costs Zeny. Q. How do I get costumes? A. From field hunting, boss monsters, events, Silvervine Fruit exchanges and more. Q. Where do I get Shadow Gear? A. Shadow Gear is added step by step through Lucky Egg updates. Q. Are Enchant Stones shared across my account? A. No. Enchant Stones are registered and managed per character. Q. Can I get a specific costume directly? A. Yes. Spend 300 Costume Coins to choose the costume with the album number you want. More questions If your question is not here, see the related guide pages or contact the staff.

articles.title: General FAQ
articles.search_text: General FAQ Common questions about playing the game. Home FAQ Q. Where can I see the current server stage? A. On the Current Server Stage page or the Server Roadmap page. Q. Where can I see what comes in the next update? A. The Upcoming Updates page lists the content and systems planned next. Q. What happens when I register a costume? A. Registering a costume in the Costume Album uses up the original item and adds it to the album permanently. Q. Can my other characters use a registered costume? A. The character that registered it can use it right away. Unlock the account wardrobe and the other characters on the same account can use it too. Q. Are Costume Enchant Stones shared across my account? A. No. Enchant Stones are managed per character and are not shared with other characters. Q. Can I get a specific costume directly? A. Yes. Spend 300 Costume Coins to choose and get the costume with the album number you want. Q. Where do I get Shadow Gear? A. Shadow Gear will be added step by step through Lucky Eggs. Q. Will new costumes and Enchant Stones keep coming? A. Yes. New costumes, Enchant Stones and Shadow Gear will keep being added according to the Server Roadmap. Q. Do I need to do entry quests for content? A. Most content on the NEED server is available right away. The Warp Helper takes you there without entry quests. Q. How do I find information that is not in the wiki? A. New pages are added all the time. If you cannot find what you need, contact the staff or check back after future updates. Note FAQ answers may change with server updates.
